<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Stow a sealed case into a case bin"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/containers/{lpn}/stowages"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Scan the LPN, scan the location (ADR 0045). The bin must accept sealed cases (handling unit CASE or PALLET, as published by facility-layout); a bin whose handling unit is unknown or EACH is 409 `bin-handling-unit-mismatch` (fail closed). The first stow sets the container's site from the bin's site (a carton event carries no site) and creates the SEALED_CASE stock unit holding the case's eaches; moving a stowed container to another bin of the same site is allowed, to another site is 409 `container-not-at-site`. Stowing into the bin it is already in is a no-op.

Behind the Idempotency-Key middleware like the other creating POSTs (ADR 0018).

  id={"request"}

Postgres is the only runtime, so the check is on in every deployment: a missing key is answered with 400 `idempotency-key-required`, a malformed one with 400 `idempotency-key-invalid`; a replay with the same key and the same method, path and body returns the original response plus `Idempotency-Replayed: true`, while the same key with a different method, path or body is 409 `idempotency-key-reused`.\n","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":128,"pattern":"^[ -~]+$","example":"5b0f6a0e-6a41-4c63-9f33-0c8f5c1d2a77"}},{"name":"lpn","in":"path","required":true,"description":"The container's license plate (the carton SSCC, or an internal `LPN-<site>-<id>`).","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":64,"pattern":"^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$","example":"003400000000000017"}}]}
